identify beginner needs, common sentence patterns, likely misconceptions, accessibility requirements and appropriate pedagogical precedents."},{"id":"principles","objective":"Translate the learning objective into instructional and visual principles covering pattern reuse, progressive difficulty, contextual meaning, active recall, feedback and cognitive load."},{"id":"structure_spec","objective":"Specify the lesson architecture, progression, content hierarchy, activity cadence, assessment points and visual-asset decisions."},{"id":"expand_assets","objective":"Apply the approved system across the planned lesson set, reusable activity templates, instructional graphics, feedback states and supporting visual assets."},{"id":"deliver","objective":"Validate linguistic accuracy, instructional alignment, accessibility, consistency and file completeness, then package the education content system for
